title: Lifeline SUPPORT.yaml
description: Editor helper only. Lifeline validates SUPPORT.yaml with its own hand-written checks in src/core, not with this schema. Keep this file in sync with src/core/support.js by hand.

lines.description: One entry per release line (major version series).

stage.description: Lifecycle stage: indev (development), as (Active Support), ls (Life Support), el (End of Life).

eol.description: Planned end-of-life date for an ls line, as a YYYY-MM-DD string.

components.description: Informational only; Lifeline does not use this.
